company.name: 台灣應用材料股份有限公司 _Applied Materials Taiwan

items.text: Develop state of the art algorithms in the fields of Computer Vision, Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
Engage in customer facing activities to aid algorithms' proliferation at customer sites
Provide software specifications and production code on time to meet project milestones
Close work with the applications, system, physics, software, and qualification groups in order to understand the customers’ requirements and system constraints
Algorithm integration in large systems considering HW and SW aspects
You can experiment with data, technology, science and new methodologies like never before.
An environment where new ideas are welcome and encouraged; there is great variety in the work and no two days are the same.
The chance to seize a great opportunity to work for an innovator and market leader and use your skills to help keep Applied Materials at the forefront of the semiconductor and display market.

description.text:
【本職缺優先審核至應用材料公司官網投遞人選】請至應材官網上傳履歷表：
Talents who apply job through Applied Materials Career Website will be reviewed and considered as top priority
Please apply job here: https://careers.appliedmaterials.com/careers/job/790293826051
This opening is to collect candidate profiles instead of a real job opening - We welcome you apply this opening if you want to get into our talent database! Applied Materials values talents. We want to actively engage with each talent to build your profile into our talent database so that we can match your profile with our job openings when there is a suitable one.
投遞此職缺即會被納入台灣應用材料人才庫，未來若有合適機會人資將主動與您聯繫。
■ Key Responsibilities
1. Develop state of the art algorithms in the fields of Computer Vision, Machine Learning and Deep Learning.
2. Engage in customer facing activities to aid algorithms' proliferation at customer sites
3. Provide software specifications and production code on time to meet project milestones
4. Close work with the applications, system, physics, software, and qualification groups in order to understand the customers’ requirements and system constraints
5. Algorithm integration in large systems considering HW and SW aspects
Great Place to work as Algorithm Developer at Applied Taiwan

1. You can experiment with data, technology, science and new methodologies like never before.
2. An environment where new ideas are welcome and encouraged; there is great variety in the work and no two days are the same.
3. The chance to seize a great opportunity to work for an innovator and market leader and use your skills to help keep Applied Materials at the forefront of the semiconductor and display market.

job.title: Algorithm Developer 演算法研發工程師 (請提供英文履歷) - Location: Hsinchu

items: 數學及電算機科學學科類
key_values.label: 科系要求
key_values.text: 電機電子工程相關、數學及電算機科學學科類

items: 英文：精通、精通、精通、精通
key_values.label: 語文條件
key_values.text: 英文：精通、精通、精通、精通

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
1. MSc in Physics/ Electronics eng./ Computer Science and 3+ years of experience as Algo. developer OR
2. PhD in Physics/ Electronics eng./ Computer Science
3. Strong theoretical foundation and hands-on experience in Computer Vision and Image Processing algorithms - must
4. Thorough understanding of probability and statistics - must
5. Strong skills in developing in MATLAB – must
6. Development experience in Python - must
7. Ability to work independently as well as part of a team – must
8. Availability to travel abroad 20% of the year
9. Theoretical and hands-on experience in detection, segmentation, image enhancement and simulations– advantage
10. Theoretical and hands-on experience in Machine Learning – must
11. Theoretical and hands-on experience in Deep Learning – advantage
12. Understanding of imaging systems and physics - advantage
13. Development experience in Java and C/C++ - advantage
14. Scored TOEIC higher than 550
15. Applied Materials is committed to diversity in its workforce including Equal Employment Opportunity for Minorities, Females, Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.
